Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human target DNA polymerase iota (CHEMBL5391). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Filter for Homo sapiens assay organism. Require compound_structures joined as an INNER JOIN to ensure canonical SMILES are present. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
